context: Two friends plan to take the subway to a sports stadium via downtown
purpose: Teach: 車両/経由/地下鉄/有料/観戦/一貫/掲げ/違和感

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: やっと今日、スタジアムで観戦できるな。チケット取れてよかったよ。
lines.en: Finally we get to watch the game at the stadium today. Glad we got tickets.
lines.style: Casual upbeat tone, slightly drawn-out vowels, friendly older-brother energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん!ダウンタウン経由で行くんだよね?地下鉄が一番早いって聞いた。
lines.en: Yeah! We're going via downtown, right? I heard the subway is fastest.
lines.style: Excited teen voice, quick pace, rising intonation on questions.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう、二回乗り換えるけど、有料の特急バスより安いし確実だよ。
lines.en: Right, we transfer twice, but it's cheaper and more reliable than the paid express bus.
lines.style: Calm explanatory tone, measured pace, slight matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先頭車両に乗ろうよ。混んでる時、後ろの方ってなんか違和感あるんだよね。
lines.en: Let's ride the front car. When it's crowded, the back feels kind of off to me.
lines.style: Playful teen suggestion, slightly whiny on the complaint, casual ending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかる。俺もずっと一貫して先頭派だわ。視界も広いしな。
lines.en: I get it. I've consistently been a front-car guy too. The view's wider.
lines.style: Warm agreeing tone, light chuckle in voice, relaxed conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そういえばさ、応援団がデカい旗を掲げてるの、テレビで見たよ!
lines.en: Oh by the way, I saw the cheering squad holding up a huge flag on TV!
lines.style: Animated teen excitement, quick tempo, emphasis on デカい for impact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あれ感動するよな。スタジアム着いたら、まずグッズ売り場寄ろうか。
lines.en: That's moving, isn't it. Once we hit the stadium, should we stop by the merch booth first?
lines.style: Soft nostalgic warmth shifting to upbeat suggestion, friendly invitation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね!じゃあ次の駅で地下鉄乗り換えだから、準備しとこう。
lines.en: Sounds good! The next stop is our subway transfer, so let's get ready.
lines.style: Energetic teen agreement, brisk pace, slight rising tone on suggestion.
